ABOUT THE PROJECT
Tech Park, Knowledge Park - 5

A Strategic Business Destination for IT, ITES & Commercial Development

Tech Park at Knowledge Park 5, Chauganpur, Greater Noida West, is envisioned as a modern commercial destination for businesses, technology companies, entrepreneurs and investors seeking a strategic location in the rapidly developing Greater Noida region.

Positioned within the emerging Knowledge Park 5 business ecosystem, the project offers opportunities for IT/ITES plots and commercial development in an area witnessing increasing residential, educational and commercial activity. Its location in Greater Noida West makes it suitable for businesses looking to establish a presence within the wider Delhi-NCR market.

Prime Location in Knowledge Park 5

Location plays an important role in the success of any commercial development. Tech Park is located in Knowledge Park 5, Chauganpur, Greater Noida West, an emerging business corridor that is attracting technology, commercial and institutional developments.

The surrounding area benefits from Greater Noida's planned infrastructure and its connection with major residential and commercial hubs across the NCR. The location provides businesses with access to a growing catchment of residents, professionals, students and consumers.

For companies seeking commercial space in Greater Noida West, Knowledge Park 5 presents an opportunity to establish operations in a developing business environment while remaining connected to the larger NCR region.

IT/ITES Plots Designed for Business Opportunities

The project focuses on IT/ITES and commercial plots, offering an opportunity for businesses and investors looking for land suitable for commercial development, subject to applicable approvals, zoning regulations and permitted land use.

The plots can be considered for eligible business requirements such as:

IT and IT-enabled service establishments
Corporate and professional offices
Technology companies and startups
Business centres and workspaces
Service-oriented commercial establishments
Other permitted commercial activities

The combination of a strategic location and an expanding surrounding ecosystem makes the project relevant for businesses looking beyond conventional commercial properties.

Why Knowledge Park 5, Greater Noida West?

Knowledge Park 5 is developing as an important part of Greater Noida's expanding commercial and institutional landscape. The wider Greater Noida region has experienced significant development in residential, educational, industrial and business infrastructure.

For entrepreneurs and companies, being located in a developing commercial zone can provide access to an expanding customer and professional base. For investors, commercial land in emerging business corridors can offer an opportunity to participate in the area's future development, subject to market conditions and applicable regulations.

Connectivity to Delhi-NCR

One of the key considerations for any commercial property is connectivity. Greater Noida West is strategically positioned within the NCR and provides access to important destinations across Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad and Delhi.

The location makes Knowledge Park 5 relevant for businesses that want to operate within the NCR while maintaining accessibility to established residential and commercial markets.

A Commercial Opportunity for Businesses & Investors

Tech Park at Knowledge Park 5 can cater to two important requirements: business establishment and long-term commercial investment.

Entrepreneurs can explore the location for setting up their business, while investors may consider commercial plots as part of a diversified real-estate portfolio. The suitability of a plot for a particular business activity should always be evaluated according to the approved layout, land-use permissions and applicable government regulations.

Who Should Consider Tech Park?

Tech Park can be relevant for a wide range of buyers and businesses, including:

IT & Technology Companies:
Businesses looking for a dedicated commercial location for their operations.

Startups & Entrepreneurs:
Founders seeking a strategic address within the expanding Greater Noida West market.

Corporate & Professional Businesses:
Companies looking for opportunities to establish offices or business facilities.

Real Estate Investors:
Investors exploring commercial land opportunities in emerging NCR business corridors.

The Future of Business in Greater Noida West

ABOUT THE PROJECT
London Mart

London Mart is presented as a world-class holistic urban commercial space in Greater Noida West, combining shopping, entertainment, dining, commerce and premium studios. The project emphasizes modern aesthetics, comfort and recreational avenues.

Retail & Lifestyle Destinations

Destination	Positioning
The Oxford Street	Designer and luxury retail destination
The Oxford Circus	Lifestyle and commercial destination
The Regent Street	Premium retail and shopping destination
The Fashion Street	Fashion-focused retail destination
The Baker's Street	Restaurant, dining and leisure destination
Premium Studios	Premium studio spaces

Experience & Positioning

Luxury shopping with designer and lifestyle merchandise.

Fine dining, food court and entertainment offerings.

Multi-screen cineplex and entertainment zone.

Banquet and premium studio spaces.

A family-oriented leisure and entertainment hub.

Brand statement: “Explore the very best of London ambiance and give wings to your dreams.”

 

The project is described as offering meticulously designed floors with ultra-modern features and an emphasis on optimum space utilization with a glamorous feel.

Project Consultants & Team

Ar. Vishal Mittal | Architect

Founder/architect associated with Space Designers International Architects Private Limited. The source states the firm was established in 1998 and describes his role in project planning and delivery.

Vishnu Dutt Sharma | Structural Engineer

Nitin Vij | Elevation Designer

ABOUT THE PROJECT
Godrej Golf Links
Godrej Golf Links Greater Noida – Luxury Villas, Apartments, Price & Floor Plans

Discover premium golfside living at Godrej Golf Links, Sector 27, Greater Noida. Spread across approximately 100 acres, this residential township combines golf-oriented living, landscaped surroundings, lifestyle amenities and connectivity to key destinations across Greater Noida and the wider NCR region.

Featuring multiple residential phases, including villas, apartments and Crown Residences, Godrej Golf Links offers homebuyers different options to explore according to their space requirements, budget and lifestyle preferences.

About Godrej Golf Links Greater Noida

Godrej Golf Links is a golf-themed residential township located in Sector 27, Greater Noida. Developed by AR Landcraft LLP, with Godrej Properties as a partner, the township has been planned around recreational facilities, residential clusters and green surroundings.

The development includes different residential formats, allowing buyers to explore homes suited to different preferences. Buyers should compare the exact phase, unit configuration, amenities, pricing and possession status before making a purchase decision.

Crown Residences at Godrej Golf Links

Crown Residences is a residential phase within the Godrej Golf Links township, marketed around premium 3 BHK and 4 BHK residences, golf views and a wellness-focused lifestyle.

Request the latest price list, floor plans, specifications, payment schedule and unit availability to identify a residence that matches your requirements.

Godrej Golf Links Price

Property prices depend on the phase, configuration, size, floor, view, inventory and applicable charges. Online listings referenced in the content have indicated starting prices around ₹2.88 crore for certain 3 BHK configurations. This is indicative information, not a live quotation.

Request a current, unit-specific quotation and confirm taxes, registration, stamp duty, parking, maintenance deposits and other applicable charges.

Location and Connectivity

Godrej Golf Links is situated at Plot REP-1, Sector 27, near Pari Chowk in Greater Noida. The location connects residents with established residential sectors, educational institutions, healthcare facilities and important road corridors.

Connectivity includes Pari Chowk, Delta Metro Chowk, the Noida-Greater Noida Expressway and the Yamuna Expressway. Actual distances and travel times may vary by route.

Amenities at Godrej Golf Links

The township’s lifestyle positioning centres on golf, recreation and landscaped surroundings. Amenities promoted across the development include a 9-hole golf course, clubhouse and community facilities, swimming facilities, fitness facilities, spa and salon facilities, sports areas and landscaped open spaces. Amenities and access rights can differ by phase.

Floor Plans and Configurations

Godrej Golf Links includes villas, apartments and other residential formats across its phases. Crown Residences is promoted with 3 BHK and 4 BHK configurations. Request the approved floor plan and verify carpet area, saleable area, balcony details, parking allocation and specifications for the exact unit.

Investment Considerations

Godrej Golf Links may appeal to buyers seeking premium residential property in Greater Noida, particularly those who value golf-oriented surroundings, lifestyle amenities and access to established transport corridors.

Consider the purchase price, rental demand, maintenance costs, resale liquidity and delivery status of the selected phase. Future appreciation and rental income are not guaranteed.

Explore Godrej Golf Links and compare available residential options. Request the latest price list, approved floor plans, project specifications, payment schedule and applicable RERA details before proceeding.

Prices, availability, amenities, specifications and possession dates may change. Verify all information with the developer and applicable official RERA records before making a purchase decision.

ABOUT THE PROJECT
Risland Sky Mansion
Risland Sky Mansion Chhattarpur – Price, Floor Plans & Amenities

Discover Risland Sky Mansion, a luxury residential development in Chhattarpur, Satbari, South Delhi. The project is marketed with spacious 3 BHK and 4 BHK apartments, exclusive 5 BHK triplex penthouses, contemporary architecture, smart-home features and views towards the Aravalli green belt.

Project Overview

Risland Sky Mansion is developed by Risland India. Published project information describes approximately 4.1 acres of land, four residential towers and around 160 residences. The project offers multiple residential configurations designed for buyers seeking spacious homes in South Delhi.

Risland Sky Mansion Price

Online listings have advertised 3 BHK apartments at approximately ₹5.1 crore onwards, 4 BHK apartments at approximately ₹7.6 crore onwards and 5 BHK triplex penthouses at approximately ₹18 crore onwards in some listings. Prices are indicative and vary according to the unit, floor, condition, interiors and transaction type. Contact a verified seller for current availability and a complete cost sheet.

3 BHK Luxury Apartments

Published 3 BHK layouts have area references of approximately 3,255 to 3,300 sq. ft. Buyers should confirm the exact unit area, floor plan, room dimensions, balcony arrangements and specifications.

4 BHK Luxury Apartments

Published 4 BHK layouts have area references of approximately 3,900 to 4,050 sq. ft. The exact area and layout depend on the selected unit.

5 BHK Triplex Penthouses

The project also features premium 5 BHK triplex penthouses, with published area references of approximately 9,450 to 11,130 sq. ft. Confirm availability, terrace access, specifications and pricing for the specific residence.

Amenities and Lifestyle

Project marketing highlights a swimming pool, children’s pool, clubhouse, fitness centre, gymnasium, spa and salon facilities, recreational spaces, landscaped gardens, smart-home features, CCTV and security systems, and concierge-related services. Confirm the operational status and applicable charges for each facility.

Location and Connectivity

Located in Chhattarpur–Satbari, South Delhi, the project offers access to Chhattarpur and Sultanpur Metro stations, Mehrauli–Gurugram Road, Vasant Kunj, Gurugram commercial districts and Indira Gandhi International Airport. Developer-published distance references include approximately 4 km to Mehrauli–Gurugram Road, 14 km to IGI Airport and 15 km to Ambience Mall, Gurugram. Actual distances depend on the route.

Smart-Home Features and Security

Selected project marketing highlights intelligent lighting, smart locks, intercom facilities and security systems. Confirm the installed equipment and specifications for the individual apartment.

Possession and RERA

Some project sources describe Risland Sky Mansion as ready to move and list RERA registration number DLRERA2018P0014. Verify the registration on the official Delhi RERA portal and obtain the relevant occupancy documentation before relying on these claims.

Is Risland Sky Mansion a Good Investment?

The project may interest buyers seeking premium residences in South Delhi. Evaluate the purchase price, maintenance expenses, property condition, resale demand, rental evidence and legal documentation. Capital appreciation and rental returns are not guaranteed.

Book a Site Visit

Contact the developer or a verified property representative to check available residences, request the latest price list, review floor plans and arrange a site visit.

Disclaimer: Prices, availability, amenities, areas and project status may change. Verify current details, legal documents and official records before making a purchase.

10 Things to Consider Before Buying Your First Home
 September 09, 2026

Buying your first home is one of the biggest financial decisions you will make. From choosing the right location to understanding your budget, there are several factors that should be considered before making a purchase.

1. Determine Your Budget

Before visiting properties, determine how much you can comfortably afford.

Your budget should include:

Property price
Down payment
Home loan EMI
Registration and stamp duty
Maintenance charges
Property taxes
Interior and renovation costs
Insurance
Utility expenses

A good property is not necessarily the most expensive property. The right property is one that fits comfortably within your long-term financial plan.

2. Choose the Right Location

Location plays a major role in both lifestyle and property appreciation.

When evaluating a location, consider:

Connectivity to major roads
Public transportation
Schools and colleges
Hospitals
Shopping centres
Restaurants and entertainment
Employment hubs
Future infrastructure projects
Security and neighbourhood quality

A property in a well-connected location can provide better convenience and potentially stronger resale value.

3. Research the Developer

If you are purchasing a property from a developer, research the developer's previous projects.

Check:

Previous delivery record
Construction quality
Customer reviews
Legal history
Project approvals
RERA registration
Maintenance standards
Quality of amenities

Never make a property decision based only on brochures or promotional advertisements.

4. Understand the Total Cost

The advertised property price may not represent the final amount you need to pay.

Ask for a complete cost sheet that includes:

CostDescription
Base Price	Price of the property
Parking	Parking allocation charges
Club Charges	Clubhouse or amenity charges
Maintenance	Advance maintenance charges
Registration	Government registration charges
Stamp Duty	Applicable stamp duty
GST	Applicable tax on eligible properties
Other Charges	Additional project-specific charges

Understanding the complete cost before booking helps avoid unexpected expenses later.

5. Check the Property Documents

Before purchasing a property, verify the necessary legal documents.

Important documents may include:

Sale deed
Title documents
Approved building plan
Encumbrance certificate
Completion certificate
Occupancy certificate
RERA registration details
Property tax receipts
Development agreement where applicable

For significant purchases, it is advisable to have the documents reviewed by a qualified property lawyer.

6. Compare Home Loan Options

If you are financing your purchase through a home loan, compare different lenders.

Look at:

Interest rate
Processing fee
Loan tenure
Prepayment conditions
EMI amount
Floating vs fixed rates
Other applicable charges

Even a small difference in interest rates can have a significant impact over a long loan tenure.

7. Visit the Property Multiple Times

Never make a final decision after visiting a property only once.

Visit at different times of the day to understand:

Traffic
Noise levels
Natural lighting
Ventilation
Parking availability
Neighbourhood activity
Accessibility

If possible, visit during both weekdays and weekends.

8. Think About Future Appreciation

Real estate should be evaluated from both a lifestyle and investment perspective.

Factors that may influence future property demand include:

New highways
Metro connectivity
Business districts
Commercial developments
Schools and universities
Healthcare facilities
Shopping and entertainment
Government infrastructure projects

However, future appreciation is never guaranteed, so investment decisions should not rely solely on projected returns.

9. Evaluate Amenities

Modern residential projects often provide a wide range of amenities.

Popular amenities include:

Swimming pool
Gymnasium
Clubhouse
Children's play area
Landscaped gardens
Walking tracks
Sports facilities
Security systems
Multipurpose halls
Co-working spaces

Consider whether you will actually use the amenities rather than paying a premium simply because they are advertised.

10. Think Long Term

A home should ideally meet your needs for several years.

Consider questions such as:

Will the home be large enough if my family grows?

Is the location convenient for work and education?

Will the property be easy to sell or rent in the future?

Are the maintenance costs affordable?

Does the neighbourhood have good long-term potential?

Final Thoughts

Buying a home requires careful research, financial planning and legal due diligence.

Do not rush because of sales pressure or limited-time offers. Compare properties, understand the complete cost, verify documentation and choose a property that fits your financial goals and lifestyle.

The right real estate decision is not simply about buying a beautiful property—it is about making a well-informed long-term decision.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q. What is the most important factor when buying property?

Location, legal documentation, affordability and the quality of the property should all be considered together.

Q. Should I buy a ready-to-move property or an under-construction property?

Both have advantages and disadvantages. A ready property allows you to inspect the finished product, while an under-construction property may provide more options and potentially different pricing.

Q. Should I hire a property lawyer?

For a significant property purchase, professional legal review can help identify title, approval or documentation issues before you commit.

Q. Is real estate always a good investment?

No investment is guaranteed. Property performance depends on location, demand, pricing, financing costs, infrastructure and broader market conditions.

Sales Professional
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Real Estate Sales Manager to lead our sales team, drive property sales, manage client relationships, and achieve monthly and annual business targets. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of the real estate market, excellent communication skills, and proven team-management abilities.

Key Responsibilities
Lead, manage and motivate the real estate sales team to achieve assigned sales targets.
Develop and implement effective sales strategies to generate business and improve conversions.
Handle incoming leads from digital marketing, referrals, channel partners and other sources.
Monitor the complete sales cycle, from lead generation and follow-up to site visits, negotiations and closures.
Maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.
Conduct regular follow-ups with leads and ensure timely movement through the sales pipeline.
Plan and coordinate property site visits and client meetings.
Guide the sales team on product presentation, pricing, negotiation and closing techniques.
Identify new business opportunities and develop relationships with investors, channel partners and property consultants.
Track individual and team performance through regular reviews and sales reports.
Prepare sales forecasts, MIS reports and daily/weekly/monthly performance updates.
Stay updated on market trends, competitor activities, property prices and customer preferences.
Coordinate with marketing, CRM, accounts and management teams for smooth execution of sales activities.
Ensure proper documentation and compliance throughout the sales process.
Achieve individual as well as team revenue and booking targets.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Graduate degree in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in Sales or Marketing will be an advantage.
3–7 years of experience in real estate sales, preferably in residential or commercial property.
Proven track record of achieving sales targets.
Strong leadership, negotiation and team-management skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Good knowledge of the local real estate market and customer segments.
Ability to handle multiple leads and sales activities simultaneously.
Proficiency in MS Excel, CRM systems and basic sales reporting.
Strong customer relationship and problem-solving abilities.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Monthly and quarterly booking targets
Revenue achievement
Lead-to-site-visit conversion
Site-visit-to-booking conversion
Team productivity and performance
Lead follow-up and CRM discipline
Channel partner business generation
Customer satisfaction and repeat/referral business
What We Offer
Competitive salary with attractive performance-based incentives
Growth opportunities within the organization
Professional and supportive work environment
Exposure to premium residential and commercial real estate projects
Opportunity to build and lead a high-performing sales team
